headline: Broadcom, Oracle and SpaceX are reportedly lining up huge financing deals from private lenders to pay for AI chips.
score_reason: Pool score 6 kept: the headline says talks, which matches the article; talks are early, so the summary says so.
importance_line: It shows AI chip buyers turning to private credit because bond markets are stretched, but the deals are early and their size could change.
summary: The Wall Street Journal reports, citing people familiar with the talks, that Broadcom is working to raise more than $50 billion for a custom AI chip it is building with OpenAI, and that Oracle is in talks with Apollo and Goldman Sachs to fund a large chip purchase. This follows our 7 Oct item on SpaceX's $40 billion financing talks (FT); the new points today are the Broadcom and Oracle talks, which the Journal says are at an early stage and could change in size.
